entries.title: A crewmate's model name no longer sits on a plate
entries.body: The name above a crewmate in the crew graph is now plain text. Pointing at it, or focusing it, no longer paints a solid background or a border behind the words. The name still brightens, and resting on it still opens the same summary.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
